top_candidates.title: Who is watching / paying: member vs. viewer vs. audience/fan vs. subscriber vs. customer vs. user
top_candidates.note: 'Member' is the term that survives across three surfaces (help, culture, tudum) for the person with a Netflix account/relationship. Tudum's own editorial voice, though, names the person on the other end of the screen 'viewer' almost every time -- 86 occurrences, zero of which are 'member'.
